# Contributing to Nimbus

Thanks for wanting to help. Nimbus is a downstream game streaming host fork, so
the most useful contributions are focused, reproducible, and easy to review.

Please read the full guide before opening a pull request:

- [docs/contributing.md](../docs/contributing.md)

For security-sensitive reports, do not open a public issue with exploit details.
Read:

- [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md)
